CONFLICT: This clashes with something that is already saved. Please refresh and try again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
STALE_VERSION: This was changed somewhere else. Reload to see the latest version, then try again.
UNAVAILABLE: A service we rely on is not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information is not valid. Please check it and try again.
